title: Listen: Bolts provides the guest mix on Colpey Calling x The Fix
content:
5th April 2016

Our guest for the latest Colpey Calling x The Fix show was Luke Bolton, AKA Bolts, resident DJ at So Flute in Manchester and a founding member of Fly High Society.
